title: Highlights of Holland Private Guided Tour from Amsterdam
overview: Immerse yourself in Dutch culture, history, and cuisine on a private 6- to 7-hour countryside tour. Comfortable and swift transportation takes you from the tourist crowds of Amsterdam and into the heart of Holland. Enjoy engaging commentary from your guide as you taste local cheese, stroll past windmills, and try on wooden shoes. Tour highlights include Zaanse Schans, the fishing village of Marken, Volendam, Church Broek, and more.
inclusions: Entrance fee to a windmill at The Zaanse Schans
startDescription: Hotel pickup in Amsterdam as confirmed at booking.

title: Private Tour: Amsterdam City Walking Tour and Canal Cruise
overview: Discover the delights of Amsterdam on a private, customizable half-day walking tour of the city’s historical and cultural highlights. With your personal guide, stroll through iconic locations like Dam Square and Leiden Square. Pass by landmarks such as the Rijksmuseum and Anne Frank House, and take a walk through the country's largest street market, Albert Cuyp. Conclude your tour with a scenic canal cruise, discovering Amsterdam's charm from the water.
inclusions: Hotel/ port pickup if situated in central Amsterdam

title: Amsterdam Food Tour in Jordaan District With Secret Food Tours
overview: Gain a rare perspective of Dutch cuisine on this food and culture tour through Amsterdam’s Jordaan district. Going with a guide ensures you hear little-known anecdotes about top landmarks and get a behind-the-scenes look at hidden gem eateries loved by locals. Break up the walking tour with food and drink tastings such as poffertjes (traditional batter treat), fresh herring, apple cake, and other Dutch treats along the way.
startDescription: Anne Frank Monument, Westermarkt 74, 1016 DL Amsterdam, Netherlands

title: Zaanse Schans Windmills & Zaandam: Countryside Electric Bike Tour
overview: Hop on an e-bike to see the Netherlands the local way, on two wheels. This small-group tour takes you to Zaanse Schans to pedal amid its windmills and the village of Zaandam where traditional wooden houses provide the backdrop. Ample time is included to explore on foot, take photos, and check out stalls selling Dutch cheese and clogs.
inclusions: Rain Poncho - available at the shop
Electric Bike for the tour: these are NOT scooters

title: Private Amsterdam Red Light District and Food Tour
overview: Discover the truth behind the famous Amsterdam Red Light District on a private tour. It's a great way for first-time visitors to orient themselves in the Netherlands’ capital. As you stroll along the UNESCO-listed Amsterdam Canal Ring, you’ll pass Oude Kerk (Old Church) and explore Chinatown. Plus, stop to sample three Dutch specialities, including cheese, kroket (croquette), and stroopwafel (thin waffles).
inclusions: Pick your own departure time between 13:00 - 21:00
startDescription: ParkBee Parking NH Collection Amsterdam Barbizon Palace, Prins Hendrikkade 59, 1012 AD Amsterdam, Netherlands
notes: Live USD From$118.40; 4.7/104. No numbered What To Expect POIs; used verified Oude Kerk, Chinatown, and Amsterdam Canal Ring names from the live overview.

title: Amsterdam Jordaan Food & Drinks Tour with Eating Europe
overview: Relish the delectable bites and cultural highlights of Amsterdam’s sophisticated Jordaan district on a food and walking tour. With an expert epicurean guide, visit local foodie hotspots to sample Dutch delicacies such as creamy, award-winning Gouda paired with wine and Dutch salami. Enjoy a calmer experience with several sit-down tastings as you discover places off the conventional tourist trail.
inclusions: 12 premium food tastings at 6 authentic local establishments (enough for a hearty meal)
4 relaxed sit-down tasting experiences where you can dine like a local (not just "eat and go")
A complete drinks package: coffee/tea, water, soda, local beer, fine wine & traditional jenever

title: 10 Tastes of Amsterdam: Food Tour by UNESCO Canals and Jordaan
overview: Eat your way around Amsterdam on this small-group food tour. It includes over 10 delicious tastings at five local eateries that most travelers miss. At each hidden gem, try Dutch delicacies, from freshly-made stroopwafels (syrup-filled waffles) to artisanal Gouda cheese. As you take a leisurely stroll between locations, see the canals that Amsterdam is famous for, and ask your guide for recommendations.
inclusions: Become Dutch in 3 hours: Eat, laugh and learn with our Expert local guides and max 10 foodies.
Eat 750 Years of Amsterdam: 10 Premium tastings at 5+ beloved local spots —enough for a nice meal

title: The Original Amsterdam City Highlights Bike Tour (EN/NL/DE)
overview: Enjoy an alternative sightseeing experience of Amsterdam on an exciting bike tour of the dazzling Dutch capital. Follow a professional guide through the quaint waterways and winding cobbled streets of the city and discover an eclectic selection of sights off the conventional tourist trail. Delve into the rich history and coffee shop culture of the city with your knowledgeable guide and get local recommendations from your local guide.
inclusions: 2.5 hour guided Amsterdam City Bike Tour (including bike)

title: Countryside Bike Tour from Amsterdam: a Windmill and Dutch Cheese
overview: Explore the Dutch countryside on this guided bike tour from Amsterdam. Choose from a short route with a standard bike or a long route on an electric bike (minimum height for the longer tour is 155cm or 5' 1"), which lets you cover more ground without breaking a sweat. Visit a mix of historical windmills, farmlands, classic Dutch landscapes, and UNESCO-listed canals. Plus, you'll stop to sample Dutch cheese, too. Note: both tours are only for experienced and fit cyclists.
itineraryStops: Irene Hoeve Clogs and Cheese Shop

title: Amsterdam Morning or Afternoon Small-Group Walking Tour
overview: This small-group walking tour gives you an insider’s view of the beautiful city of Amsterdam. An informative guide leads your group around Amsterdam’s historical center and past top attractions such as Dam Square, the Royal Palace, Nieuwmarkt, and the Red Light District. During your stroll, discover historical stories and snap photos of the UNESCO-listed canals and 17th-century gabled houses.
inclusions: PPE for guides- Hand Sanitizer for guests

title: Day Trip to Zaanse Schans, Edam, Volendam and Marken from Amsterdam
overview: Discover the Dutch countryside on this full-day tour to Zaanse Schans, Edam, Volendam, and Marken, with round-trip transfer from central Amsterdam ensuring a hassle-free trip. See windmills, waterlands, cheese makers, and clog factories up close, and learn about the region's rich history directly from your professional guide, with tasters of cheese and other local produce and interior tours included in the price. If option selected, you embark on a 1-hour canal sightseeing tour right after the tour, ending at Amsterdam Central Station.
inclusions: Tasting of local cheese and other products like cookies , fruits wine

title: Amsterdam Classic Saloon Boat Cruise, Drinks and Cheese Option
overview: Elevate your Amsterdam canal cruise when you book this experience aboard a classic covered wooden saloon boat. Cruise along the UNESCO-listed canals and see famous sights like the Anne Frank House, the Rijksmuseum, and the picturesque Jordaan district while listening to commentary from your onboard guide. Depart from two central locations, with an option to include a platter of Dutch cheese with mustard and sip unlimited beer, wine, and soft drinks.
inclusions: Unique experience on a luxury boat
2 types of Dutch Cheese & Unlimited wine, beer, soft drinks (if option selected)
